text: Takko are blue alien cephalopod creatures with Blooper-like eyes that appear in Yoshi's Crafted World. They only appear in the Moon portion of The Countdown Begins, and cannot be defeated or turned into eggs. A Takko can be used as a springboard if Yoshi jumps on it, making it expel a cloud of ink. If Yoshi Ground Pounds it, he will be propelled higher. The ink scares nearby Shy Guys, causing them to run away; this method is used to lure Shy Guys carrying Red Coins from underneath a semi-solid platform. Yoshi can also carry Takko in his mouth, and spit them into a new position. However, if a Takko is left in the same position for too long, it will teleport back to its original spot.

Sprites (also lowercase) are a species of faries hailing from the in Peaceful Woods and Toad's main allies in the Wario's Woods games. In the sprites, they look like a classic pixie with a magic wand, transparent bug wings, and a pompom floppy hat.

Small Chomps, referred to as Mini Chomps in Super Mario Galaxy, are diminutive Chain Chomps in Super Mario Galaxy and Super Mario Galaxy 2. They behave like their larger counterparts, but they are slightly shorter than Mario and generally rarer enemies. They are nearly indestructible. Small Chomps are comparable to the Chain Chomplets from Super Mario Sunshine and have a similar bark.

Silver the Hedgehog, commonly known as simply Silver, is a crossover character from the franchise. He is a hedgehog from the future who has the ability to use psychokinesis which allows him to move objects with the power of his mind. Silver's only appearances in the Super Mario franchise are in the Mario & Sonic series. He was originally voiced by Pete Capella, who voiced him in Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Winter Games; but was later replaced by Quinton Flynn, who voiced him until 2017. later replaced Flynn in 2019, first voicing him in the Super Mario franchise in Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games Tokyo 2020.

Sheila Pontoons is an alleged character appearing in the International Enquisitor section following the Game Boy comic Pipes is Pipes. According to the story "Telepathic Tuna!", she is a renowned psychic who has mentally communicated with several marine life. She mentions that though "[they're] very smart", it is expected, as "they're always in schools", with the picture on the right showing her using her mind to communicate to fish. As with most other stories in the International Enquisitor, Sheila Pontoons's story, as well as herself, are most likely fabricated, given that the newspaper is a tabloid newspaper.

Pyrogeddon is a Spark that appears in Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope. It is located in the Darkmess Puddle battle A Cold Greeting. After the battle, Pyrogeddon joins the heroes on their adventure. In battle, Pyrogeddon's ability is Skyrain Burn, which causes flaming meteors to rain down around the Hero, damaging enemies, destroying cover, and causing the Burn Super Effect. Pyrogeddon can be upgraded by feeding it Star Bits, which increases the damage dealt by the meteors. Its passive ability is Burn Protector, which decreases the damage received by Super Effects and makes the Hero resistant to the Burn Super Effect. Miss Cluck the Insincere is the third boss in Yoshi's Woolly World. She appears as the castle boss of World 3 in Miss Cluck the Insincere's Castle. She is the only Miss Cluck that has only one Peeply and has the ability to fly.

Mecha Patakuri is a robot Flying Goomba that appears in Super Mario: Yoshi no Road Hunting 1 of the Super Mario Kodansha manga. Like the name suggests, it is identical to Mecha Kuribō from the Super Mario Land manga, but has jet-plane wings instead of the arms. Held hostage with his granddaughter in Bowser's Castle, Dr. Mario Nakamatsu is forced to build weapons for Bowser. When he is left alone in his lab, the doctor creates the Super Scope and Mecha Patakuri to deliver it to Mario. Unfortunately, the Koopalings notices this, and Wendy shoots down the robot, which lands in Bertha's farm, where she claims the weapon. They wear a white cloak, and have long, white hair that covers their eyes, and float above the ground. Medicians have the ability to use the Heal Technique to heal themselves and other enemies around them by 20% of their max HP, in a way that is similar to Supporters from Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle. They also have the ability to provide one shield charge to themselves and their allies, similar to Princess Peach's Team Barrier with their Protection Technique. The Dark Barribad is an enemy from Super Paper Mario in the Flopside Pit of 100 Trials. The Dark Barribad projects an impenetrable barrier around itself when Mario, Princess Peach, Bowser, or Luigi approach, and shoots rings of energy at them. Due to the floors in the Pit of 100 Trials being a part of the wall and the Dark Barribad being placed on one of the upper floors, the player can only enter the barrier by flipping if the Dark Barribad is on the ground, otherwise they will fall to the ground from higher in the room. MC Ballyhoo and Big Top are major characters from Mario Party 8, in which they host the annual Star Carnival and all its attractions. MC Ballyhoo is the self-proclaimed "master of catastrophes", while his hat, Big Top, serves as cohost. MC Ballyhoo is very extravagant and energetic in both speech and manner, while Big Top is more reserved. Although the two rarely separate, they are separate entities capable of independent thought, speech, and action. MC Ballyhoo is the creator of the Star Carnival. Luiginoids can be activated with Dreamy Luigi when the player is near a Luiginoid Formation. They can be transformed into three forms: the Luiginary Stack (which can activate the moves Jump, Lean Over, Ground Pound, Crouch, and Spring Jump), the Luiginary Typhoon (which can activate the moves Spin Jump, Hover Spin, and Tornado), and the Luiginary Ball (which can activate the moves Ball Hammer and Hookshot). Kuruma Daikichi also appears as a character in the sample movie "SPEED". In the movie, he is introduced as an example of a person whose personality changes while driving. Krushy is a young, green Kremling who appears as one of the main characters of the French programming block DKTV, alongside the Kongs. He was added to the block after it was retooled from Donkey Kong Planet. He is the only major character of DKTV who does not appear in the Donkey Kong Country television series and is not a Kong. He is portrayed by Philippe Sax. Krushy's model and name are based on Krusha's from the television series. He dons a white hat depicting a Kremling's head, black shoes, white shorts, and a black shirt with the letters "KR" on it. Kuro Neko (lit. "black cat") is a character in Wario Land 4. She acts as Wario's enigmatic guide throughout the game. The cat's true form is Princess Shokora of the Golden Pyramid, who once ruled the area. The cat makes small appearances throughout the game, such as on the map screen, and within the corridors before facing an area boss. In the final boss area, Kuro Neko can be seen transforming from the shop owner, an additional form who runs the game's Item Shop. The cat makes a prominent appearance in the end-game sequences, where she leads Wario out of the Golden Pyramid and her true princess form is revealed. He is an old Toad with long mustache and eyebrows, a tall mushroom cap with vertical stripes, and what looks like a bald spot on the top. He debuts in the Dr. Mario manga. During a pandemic created by Gahaha Daiō, his village is spared from the virus due to an unknown factor. Mario, Peach, and Daisy go to investigate. Kinoko Sennin approaches them first, but as he explains, he and his villagers were not even aware of the virus or why they are immune to it. He is Daisy's father, husband of the late queen and the king of Dinohattan prior to the film's plot where President Koopa overthrows his government. For the entirety of the film, he appears as a giant sentient fungus after having de-evolved by President Koopa. He served as royalty of Dinohattan, ruling with his wife. Kackles are enemies exclusively appearing in Donkey Kong Country 2: Diddy's Kong Quest and its remake. These ghostly, skeletal Kremlings wear eyepatches with a human Jolly Roger and bandannas. They have the ability to hover around. Kackles exclusively appear in Haunted Hall, where four appear, each in their own gated section. Every Kackle wears a differently colored bandana: the first Kackle's is blue; the second Kackle's is green; the third Kackle's is yellow; and the last Kackle's is red. All Kackles wear blue bandanas in the remake. Hisstocrat (pink) is a boss in Super Mario 3D World and Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury. Like her companion, Hisstocrat (pink) wears regal attire, with hers resembling a queen outfit, but wears a silver crown instead of a golden one and a yellow, diamond-shaped brooch instead of a blue, circle-shaped one. Hisstocrat (pink) serves as the boss of Hisstocrat Returns, and reappears alongside the male Hisstocrat as two simultaneous bosses in Boss Blitz. She fights very similarly to her companion, where the only difference is that she rains fireballs instead of boulders upon emerging from the ground, which leave temporary fiery puddles the player must avoid, and she also spits fire. E~Bō is the ninth sample talent in Mario Artist: Talent Studio. According to their talent no namae profile, they are a brown and white child robot who comes from the near future and whose hobby/specialty is "flying through the sky".

The Dryad is a minor character in Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope residing in Spellbound Woods in Palette Prime. She is a small female Rabbid with red-orange pine cone-like hair. She has red eyes, along with long black eyelashes. The tips of her feet glow red. The Dryad also possesses the ability to float above the ground.

Dreamy Paratroopas are completely orange, glowing Paratroopas created by Dreamy Bowser for support in the final battle of Mario & Luigi: Dream Team, along with Dreamy Bob-ombs, Dreamy Goombas, Dreamy Shy Guys, and Shy Guy Airtubs DX. When attacking alongside other dreamy minions, Dreamy Paratroopas will fly straight towards the Bros., but will fall to the ground and spin their shell at them when they get closer. Mario and Luigi can jump on their shells to send them flying back to any minions behind them. Of all the dreamy minions, they have the lowest HP but the highest DEF.

Dossunmengyo is a Thwomp-faced fish that briefly appears in Super Mario-kun Volume 9, based on the , creatures with both human and fish qualities from Japanese folklore. It was born from the chaotic force that fell upon the Mushroom Kingdom. Mario, Luigi, Yoshi, and Birdo meet the Dossunmengyo while traversing a desert. They try to drink from an oasis lake, only to be attacked by the Dossunmengyo, armed with a fork and fire breath. They escape unharmed, due to the monster not being able to leave the water, and it is never seen again.

Dolloxes (originally known as Remo Cons) are robotic marionettes that can be found in Booster Tower in Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars and its remake. Its original name comes from the Japanese term「リモコン」(Rimokon), which is derived from the English term "remote control". Like other creatures in the tower, they are probably used for Booster's entertainment. Dolloxes usually aid other minions of Booster in battle, but never fight on their own. They attack by striking an opponent with their hammers, and can also perform the powerful Body Slam attack by swinging said hammers with extreme force. The Debidebi-dan is the group lead by Debidebi Daiō in the after-story of Wario Land: Super Mario Land 3 in the Super Mario Kodansha manga. Using his brainwashing powers, Debidebi Daiō takes control over Wario and Luigi and makes them the first members, he then recluts two former members of the Brown Sugar Pirates, Minotaur (who was resurrected) and Bobo, who were not brainwashed. Minotaur, through his gay personality, manages to quickly fraternize with all the male members of the crew, while Bobo is against his view on females. Diaval is the tritagonist in the film Maleficent and its sequels. He is a raven and the confidant of Maleficent. Under her command, he can take on not just the form of a human but also a variety of other creatures such as a wolf, a horse and a dragon that Maleficent turned him into. All his transformations appear very bird-like. In human form, he dresses in black and has a collection of huge visible scars all over his body. Diaval is based on the character Diablo from Disney's 1959 film Sleeping Beauty.

Aadam is a character from Marvel Comics, who appears within the Marvel Cinematic Universe. He made his debut in the third episode of the Disney+ series, Ms. Marvel, and is portrayed by Ali Alsaleh. Aadam is a member of the Clandestines. He is a Djinn, originating from the Noor Dimension, who was exiled to Earth, and has been searching a way to return home, ever since. He and the other members of the group sought Kamala Khan, who possessed the key in their returning home, in the form of her bangle. Demon Bear, is a Marvel Comics character who appeared as the secondary antagonist in The New Mutants. He is a demon that takes on the appearance of a ferocious bear, which is Danielle Moonstar's worst fear. The Demon Bear was created by Chris Claremont and Bob McLeod.

Derrick, also known as Experiment 566, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to drill potholes in hard surfaces. His one true place is with Mrs. Hasagawa as one of her "cats."

Cornelia Hale is one of the five main characters from the comic book and TV series W.I.T.C.H. She seems to be a stereotypical girl of the kind whose interest is seeming worthy of both love and envy. However, her character develops much in other directions as the story goes on. She can manipulate earth, stone, metal, wood and speaks with the Earth, making plants and flowers grow big and tall, can move objects with her mind (telekinesis/psychokinesis), and can sometimes experience prophetic visions from the earth.

Concetta and Pinuccia Aragosta are characters featured in the 2021 Disney/Pixar animated feature film, Luca. They are a pair of elderly women who live in Portorosso who are later revealed to be sea monsters in disguise.

Chessur is a major character in the 2010 film Alice in Wonderland and a supporting character in its sequel Alice Through the Looking Glass. He is a Cheshire cat with evaporating and shapeshifting skills, a sarcastic and slightly dark personality, and a stealthy attitude.

Checkers, also known as Experiment 029, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to give his wearer the power of command over all living creatures, with the exception of experiments created after him, as well as the blind and nearsighted; his hypnotic effects vanish instantly as soon as he leaves his wearer's head.

Zandrya is the main antagonist of the Disney Jr. animated series Sofia the First: Royal Magic. She is a powerful, wicked, and entitled sorceress who goes after magical items to give herself more power. And because Sofia grows more confident in her magical abilities, she has a hard time getting what she wants. As a master of disguise, Zandrya can take on different forms each time she appears in the show to fool Sofia and get her hands on the magic amulet.

Zelma Stanton is a Marvel Comics character that appears in Ironheart. While appearing as an unassuming civilian, Zelma is actually a Master of the Mystic Arts, being a powerful sorceress and Doctor Strange and Wong's personal librarian. After losing the Hood, Parker Robbins meets her, hoping that she would use her magic and knowledge to somehow restore his power. Zelma Stanton was created by Jason Aaron and Chris Bachalo.

Wolfsbane, is a Marvel Comics character who appeared in The New Mutants, played by Maisie Williams. She is a Scottish mutant with the ability to transform into a werewolf. Wolfsbane was created by Chris Claremont and Bob McLeod.
Wolfie is the Hauntleys' family dog in Vampirina, who can turn into a werewolf during a full moon or whenever he drinks milk.

Wong is a Marvel Comics character, who appears in the multiple films of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, debuting in Doctor Strange. The Ancient One assigns Wong to become Stephen Strange's teacher, and has helped Strange master his skills and become one of Strange's allies. Wong is an expert magic user and a master martial artist, who later becomes the Sorcerer Supreme on a technicality after Strange blips for five years. Wong was created by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko.

Wilhelmina "Will" Vandom is the leader of W.I.T.C.H. and the keeper of the Heart of Kandrakar. She moves to Heatherfield after leaving her hometown of Fallen Hills. Her powers include bringing electrical appliances to life, granting them distinct personalities and the ability to speak. Talking with and understanding animals is also one of her capabilities. In issue 80 (emotions), Will's half-brother William was born. Later on, William found that he is magical like Will as well.
Weebo is the tritagonist of Disney's Flubber. She is a hovering sentient robot who was created by Philip Brainard to act as his assistant.

Welko, also known as Experiment 074, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. She is designed to blow temporary indestructible bubbles. She appears in the Stitch! anime.

The Were-Rat is one of the antagonists in the 2012 film Frankenweenie. He is a dead rat who was taken by Edgar "E" Gore to test it on a science experiment. His experiment mutated the rat, who grew to the size of a child and went on a rampage with the other monsters.

Wanda-Merlin (real name Wanda Maximoff) is a character who appears in the What If...? episode "What If... The Avengers Assembled in 1602?" This version of Scarlet Witch is a court sorceress of the Asgardian Royal Family, dubbed Wanda-Merlin and Scarlet Witch, during the paradox period where the 17th and 21st Centuries were merged. Scarlet Witch was created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby. The Marvel version of the mythological Merlin was created by Dan Barry and Allen Bellman.

Vivian, better known as Viv, is a character on the Disney Channel series That's So Raven. She is portrayed by Jenifer Lewis. She is the maternal grandmother of Raven and Cory Baxter, and the mother of Tanya Baxter. Viv makes her only appearance in the episode "To See or Not to See," where she reveals to Raven that she is also a psychic.

Vigor is a deleted character from earlier versions of Disney's 2010 animated film Tangled. He later appears as a character in Rapunzel's Tangled Adventure. He is a psychic fortune telling monkey owned by Madame Canardist.
Vaughan and Vance are the Flying Derby team of the Junior Knights Academy and are antagonists who appear in the Sofia the First episode "The Flying Crown".

Toons, also known as Experiment 112, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to turn anyone into a cartoon. When transmuted by Hämsterviel, he can transform into the subject of any drawing inserted into his mouth. When reprogrammed, he can bring 2D images to life in 3D. He appears in the Stitch! anime.

Toffee is one of the two main antagonists of the Disney XD series Star vs. the Forces of Evil. He is a mysterious being and the arch-enemy of Queen Moon Butterfly. Toffee was Ludo's most recent minion who joins his army during Season One, but later overthrows him and becomes the leader of his castle and army. During the Season One finale, he manipulates Star to destroy the wand and seemingly perishes in the ensuing explosion. However, his consciousness was stored in one of the broken halves of the wand and during Season Two, he manipulates Ludo through the wand and eventually possesses his body.

Tigger is an anthropomorphic stuffed tiger belonging to Christopher Robin that first appeared in Disney's 1968 animated featurette Winnie the Pooh and the Blustery Day. A boisterous, yet simple-minded character, Tigger is most known for his affinity for bouncing, which is made possible by the spring in his tail. His theme song, "The Wonderful Thing About Tiggers", illustrates that Tigger is one-of-a-kind, a distinction in which he prides himself.

Thresher, also known as Experiment 544, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to thrash crops and beat his victims up with his mace-like tentacles. He was captured by Gantu, but was rescued in "Snafu".
Thingy is a tiny blue furball that can transform into a large battle form of Super Robot Monkey Team Hyperforce Go! Its fur is apparently edible.

Beshte is the pentagonist of the Disney Jr. series The Lion Guard. He is a hippo and one of Kion's friends and a former member of the Lion Guard. His position on the team was the Strongest in the Pride Lands.

The Beetle (real name Abner Jenkins) is a Marvel Comics supervillain who is an exceptionally skilled mercenary. Commonly hired by Doctor Octopus, Beetle regularly ran afoul of Spider-Man, and was defeated on almost every occasion. He had temporarily joined the first Sinister Six. He later became a member of the Masters of Evil. However, when they went undercover as the superhero team the Thunderbolts, Beetle posed as the high-tech flying hero Mach IV. However, after Baron Zemo's treachery, Jenkins disposed of his identity as the Beetle and fully became Mach IV, now a genuine hero. Abner Jenkins was created by Stan Lee and Carl Burgos.

Taloa Lopez is a character in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, appearing in the Disney+ series Echo. A member of the Choctaw tribe and the mother of Maya Lopez, she possessed the ability to heal others. In 2007, she was killed in a car accident caused by tampered brakes, which left Maya with a leg amputation. Years later, Taloa appeared to Maya in a vision, providing guidance and strength during her vendetta against Wilson Fisk.
Symbie is a recurring antagonist who appears in the fifth season of Spidey and his Amazing Friends. He is a mischevious little shapeshifting Symbiote who likes to cause trouble.

Swirly, also known as Experiment 383, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to hypnotize individuals into obeying the next order or suggestion they hear; snapping one's fingers will break the victim's trance. His one true place is hypnotizing guests at children's parties.

Swapper, also known as Experiment 355, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. They are designed to switch individuals' minds; it is possible for them to swap more than two individuals at once, and they will only switch them back by choice.
Sweetums is a very tall Muppet ogre. His bulldog-like lower jaw, thick eyebrows, shabby brown shirt, and threatening expression belie his more or less friendly and lovable nature.

Strelitzia is a Keyblade wielder who appears in Kingdom Hearts Union χ. She is a member of the Dandelions and the younger sister of Lauriam, the somebody of Marluxia. After the First Keyblade War, Strelitzia was chosen to lead a Union and she was given a book with laws set by Master Ava, However, Strelitzia was struck down and had her book stolen by Darkness, who was possessing Ventus. While Ventus took her place as Union Leader, Strelitzia mysteriously disappeared and was assumed dead. Lauriam also became a leader and searched for his sister with no avail. Eventually, Strelitzia is revealed to be alive, having actually been transported to the world Quadratum.

Sun Yee is the ancestor of the characters in Disney•Pixar's 2022 animated feature film Turning Red. She is the first of Mei's family to be blessed with the ability to turn into a red panda and had passed her blessing from the gods down to her descendants.

Splodyhead, also known as Experiment 619 and Splody, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to attack using fiery plasma blasts from his nozzle-like nose; he can also pitch softballs similarly. His one true place is lighting tiki torches at the luau.

Spooky, also known as Experiment 300, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to terrify entire populations into submission by morphing into their worst fears; his forms are distinguishable by his glowing green eyes and hissing voice. His one true place is scaring trick-or-treaters on Halloween and (for the rest of the year) haunting the old, abandoned mansion.

The Somnambulist is the main antagonist in the Teamo Supremo episode: "Things That Go Bump in the Night!." He was once the state’s leading dream researcher, but when he was denied a grant for some radical new dream research, he swore revenge against the entire state. He created a “Dream Beam” ray that would give the children of the state nightmares. His plan was to steal a rocket in order to send his Dream Beam into space so that it would have enough power to give nightmares to both adults and children alike. Then everyone would have to turn to him for help for which he would charge them and become rich. He was eventually foiled by Teamo Supremo. He is assisted by a trio of henchman known as

Skye is an enthusiastic flying unicorn, who appears in the Disney Jr. animated series Sofia the First. He has a noble personality and is protective of Sofia and Amber, calling them his princesses. He is a colt, who has just earned his wings, so he struggles with flight at times.

Skip, also known as Experiment 089, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to skip time by ten minutes, but had a flaw in his programming that made him skip ahead ten years instead. When used by someone, the individual and whoever is beside him will travel forward in time by one decade. Luckily, he has a reset button that will bring the time travelers back to the original time they started in.

Sir Hiss is the tertiary antagonist in Disney's 1973 animated feature film Robin Hood. He is Prince John's snake advisor and assistant. Hiss has the power of hypnosis, which he uses to send King Richard on a crusade, thus allowing himself and Prince John to rule over England.

Shrink, also known as Experiment 001, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is Jumba's first experiment created with Hämsterviel and to be assigned a number. He is designed to shrink and/or enlarge objects and individuals. When he was created, Hämsterviel presumably christened him Shrink. After his creation, the press posted stuff about him in the papers, and it is said that the two scientists opened up a joke shop together and began working on Jumba's many other experiments.

Saleem is a character within the Marvel Cinematic Universe. He made his debut in the third episode of the Disney+ series, Ms. Marvel, and is portrayed by Dan Carter. Saleem is a member of the Clandestines. He is a Djinn, originating from the Noor Dimension, who was exiled to Earth, and has been searching a way to return home, ever since. He and the other members of the group seek out Kamala Khan, who is possession of a bangle, which may be an instrumental key, in their return. While in pursuit of her, Saleem was captured by the Department of Damage Control and briefly detained, before escaping their prison. He then proceeded to make his way to Karachi, where Kamala Khan was, but lost his lif

Sabretooth is a Marvel Comics character who is a mutant with the powers of a sabretooth tiger, and the arch-enemy of Wolverine. He appears in Deadpool & Wolverine, played by Tyler Mane, reprising his role from the X-Men Cinematic Universe. Sabretooth was created by Chris Claremont and John Byrne.

Clovis Cluckenhoff, better known as The Rubber Chicken, was a mutant chicken with the power to stretch his body into any shape who was framed for various crimes by the cement mutant Cement Head. He appears in the Darkwing Duck episode "Mutantcy on the Bouncy".

Robot is an antagonist in the Disney Jr. show PJ Masks. He is Romeo's self-created personal servant. His most notable ability is his very long and stretchy arms and legs which are often used to quickly get them from place to place. It is around three-to-four times larger than Romeo. It is one of the few inventions made by Romeo that has the ability to speak. Robot also serves as the main villain sidekick.

Remmy, also known as Experiment 276, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to infiltrate victims' dreams and transform them into nightmares. If the victim wakes up while Remmy is still inside, he will remain within his host's mind forever to turn all future dreams into nightmares. His one true place is at Kimo's Arcade, sending gamers into virtual realities of their fantasies after Jumba reprogrammed him.

The Pterodactyl (also known as a Pterodactylus) is a flying prehistoric reptile that appears in Gravity Falls. It was preserved in tree sap millions of years ago underneath the town of Gravity Falls, Oregon before emerging in modern day.

Prince Hugo is a supporting character who appears in the Disney Jr. animated series Sofia the First. He is a prince and the best flying horse racer in flying derby at Royal Prep Academy. Throughout the first season, he was portrayed as a bully and the central antagonist of the first season episode "Just One of the Princes" until he reforms in the second season episode "The Flying Crown".
The Pixiu is a minor antagonist that appears in DuckTales. It is a mystical dragon who can sniff out and consume gold.

Pain and Panic are the secondary antagonists of Disney's 1997 animated feature film Hercules. They are minions, a demonic duo capable of morphing into any shape imaginable, carrying out Hades' dirty work.

Arbutus is a minor character from the Disney animated series Aladdin. He is a sorcerer and an entity of nature who thinks of himself as an artist. He rules a garden of his own creation, with many plants, flowers, and trees grown into artistic and fanciful forms of beauty and expression.
Mushu is the deuteragonist of Disney's 1998 animated feature film Mulan. He is a pint-sized, fast-talking, self-absorbed Chinese dragon and the self-appointed guardian of Fa Mulan.

Mystique is an upcoming character from Marvel Comics, set to appear in the 2026 film Avengers: Doomsday. She is a mutant with the ability to shapeshift. She resides in an alternate reality and comes into conflict with the heroes of Earth-616 and Fantastic Four. Mystique was created by Chris Claremont and Jim Mooney.

Arachne is a minor character that appeared in the Hercules TV Series. She's a giant, spider-like monster with a bored, sarcastic personality who pretends to be the guardian of the Tapestry of Fate. She attempts to defeat Hercules and Icarus after catching them in her domain, but she is defeated.

Mozenrath is a recurring antagonist in the Disney 1994-1995 Aladdin animated television series. He is a young sorcerer and necromancer who rules over the Land of the Black Sand.

Morpholomew, also known as Experiment 316, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to morph organisms into an exact duplicate of any other, after seeing the target organism or a photo of it for reference; however, the recipient's vocal cords will stay identical. His one true place is at a costume store, morphing people into celebrities.

Argon the Ageless is a famed heroic warrior from eastern Fasellan. He has lived for several hundred years, at least, but never shows any sign of aging. He was the owner of Lula in his youth, the sword currently wielded by Prince Dave of Udrogoth. He is voiced by Jeff Bennett.

Mor'du is the main antagonist of the 2012 Disney•Pixar animated film Brave, and the titular protagonist of the short film The Legend of Mor'du. He is a human prince who is turned into an evil enchanted bear and King Fergus' archenemy.

Miles Tuck is an ageless character from Tuck Everlasting. He is first seen wearing a black top hat an a brown coat. He is fond of gambling. He got into a fight at a bar with his opponent and was thrown out. He got married and had two children, Beau and Anna. His wife left him and took Anna and Beau with her because she thought he sold his soul to the devil but he kept the ring. She died in an insane asylum. Anna died of influenza before she turned fifteen. Beau was eighty if he were alive.
Mezmerella is a villainess from The Incredibles comic book series that were published by Boom! Studios. As her name implies, she is a master of hypnosis.

Medusalith "Medusa" Amaquelin is a member of the Inhumans, wife to Black Bolt, and sister to Crystal Amaquelin. Medusa is best known for her long, thick head of red hair, which she can psychokinetically wield like countless extra appendages. Medusa was created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.

Meap is a recurring minor character of the popular Disney Channel animated TV show, Phineas and Ferb. In the episodes, "The Chronicles of Meap", "Meapless in Seattle", and "Meap Me in St. Louis", he is one of the main protagonists. He is an Intergalactic Security Agent who spends most of his time probing deep space for anything that would pose a threat to extraterrestrial order and safety. Though being relatively small and weak by general appearance, Meap possesses sharp wits and remarkable strength. Over the course of his career, he has faced head-on and overcome countless challenges, eventually leading himself to the respected rank he holds today.
Angus Tuck (or simply known as "Tuck") is an ageless character in Tuck Everlasting. He seems anxious, and almost depressed. He is a large man, with a sad face and baggy trousers.

Mateo de Alva is one of the three tritagonists alongside Naomi Turner and Gabe Núñez from the Disney Channel animated series Elena of Avalor. He is a master wizard, who is the Royal Wizard of Avalor and one of Elena's closest friends.

Mason Greybeck is a character and Alex Russo's love interest from Wizards of Waverly Place. He was a purebred werewolf who has been around for over 300 years. He and Alex had an on-again-off-again relationship throughout the final two seasons. Mason later returns in a dream to Alex when she finds herself in another dimension after going through the rift and Mason is revealed to have died at some point. His spirit visits Alex and says his final goodbye to her, telling her he will always be watching over her as she lives her life with her husband and daughter.

Mary Sanderson is one of the secondary antagonists in Disney's 1993 film Hocus Pocus and its 2022 sequel, along with her sister, Sarah. She is the middle witch, who lived during the time of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salem_witch_trials the Salem Witch Trials], along with her two sisters: Winifred and Sarah. After three hundred years, Mary and her sisters were awoken from their graves by Max Dennison and sought to keep themselves from dying and aging once more by attempting to kidnap children and steal their souls. She has the ability to sniff out the presence of children.
The Mare of the Mist is a flying horse who appears in the Disney Jr. animated series Sofia the First.

John Jameson is a Marvel Comics character and supervillain. He is the son of J. Jonah Jameson and an astronaut for N.A.S.A. The reason why is being due to his estranged relationship with his father like in the Marvel Comics. However, the discovery of the Godstone during a space expedition causes him to transform into the lycanthropic Man-Wolf. He debuts in the Ultimate Spider-Man episode "The Man-Wolf". Man-Wolf was created by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko.

Mal is the main protagonist of the first saga of the Descendants films. She is the daughter of Maleficent and Hades, and the wife of King Ben. She is currently the Queen of the United States of Auradon and the Isle of the Lost. Mal takes charge of carrying out her mother's evil plan to steal the Fairy Godmother's magic wand and enjoys drawing and casting spells (but only if needed). As the movie progresses, Mal lets go of much of her former fears and goals, becoming in tune with her true self; thus she abandons the hollow life of evil, for a life of good. With friendship and love, Mal ended filling the hole in her that could not be satisfied through what her mother had taught her.

Magica De Spell is a major villain from the Scrooge McDuck comics, created by Carl Barks. She is an evil sorceress who first appeared in Barks' 1961 comic The Midas Touch with the goal to obtain Scrooge's Number One Dime, in order to be able to make an amulet that will give her the Midas Touch.

Ma Parker is the main antagonist of the Bonkers episode "Calling All Cars". Ma Parker is a Toon tow truck who has tricked Lucky into thinking she's really sweet, but is found out by Bonkers is that she's really a criminal who is stealing parts of their police car to build a suit of armor for a monster truck rally. With her armor, she is nearly invulnerable from the outside, but Bonkers tricks her into opening her hood. Despite her efforts, Ma is helpless as Bonkers tinkers with her engine until she is unable to move. He then proceeds to arrest the immobilized Toon truck.

Luca Paguro is the titular protagonist of the 2021 Disney•Pixar animated feature film Luca. He is a sea monster that is influenced by his new-found best friend Alberto Scorfano to venture into the surface. Once he discovers his parents will send him to the deep, away from the surface, he and Alberto escape to the town of Portorosso, Italy, and enter the Portorosso Cup so they can buy a Vespa and see the world together.

The Loth-Wolves are rare predators native to Lothal in Star Wars Rebels. They have a deep connection with the Force, and serve as the guardians of their world. For hundreds of years, Loth-Wolves had thought to have perished until they began to reappear at the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Little Bits is a character from "The Stray". She's a kitten who is hired as a bounty hunter by Lord Hater. She used her natural hypnotism abilities to lure Wander into a trap, and is the main antagonist in her debut episode. She mostly stays silent as part of her deceptive cover, but when she talks, she speaks with a cute lisp. As of "My Fair Hatey", she is one of Lord Dominator's prisoners.

Laszlo is a character from Disney's 2007 animated feature film Meet the Robinsons. The son of Fritz and Petunia Robinson and the brother of Tallulah Robinson, he is a painter that uses a special flight pack.

Jormungandr is a character that appears in the DuckTales reboot. The legendary World Serpent of Norse Mythology, Jormungandr can take on the form of a humanoid snake man wrestler to give his opponents a fair fight.

In the episode "Echoes of the Past", Hooty reveals he can disconnect with the house and ride in a cuckoo clock style backpack to travel to areas not on the Isle itself. Doing this however, he exposes his internal organs causing people to get sick at the sight of it.

Heimdall is the all-seeing and all-knowing Asgardian warrior god and the guardian of the rainbow bridge, the Bifrost, watching for any attacks on Asgard. This version of the mythological Heimdall was created by Stan Lee, Jack Kirby, and Larry Lieber.

Kuon (KOO-ohn), Ogre Ascendant was an enlightened Ogre Monk from Kamigawa who was active during the Kami War.

The ruler vehemently refused Drathka, but the wizard spat an evil threat before teleporting away. The outcome of this dispute is unknown.

In Trollan society, showing one's face to another is considered an intimate act, similar to humans sharing a kiss. Trollans also have purple blood. Trollans appear to be blue-skinned humanoids with pointy ears. However, their feet remain hidden under their robes. Judging by the length of Orko's arms, Trollans have a physical stature similar to apes. Trollans have natural magical abilities, including levitation, which they exclusively use instead of walking, which may explain their very short legs.

Casillas is a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier who served with Fireteam Castle on the . In February 2558, Casillas and the rest of Fireteam Castle were killed after their Pelican was shot down by Jul 'Mdama's forces while on a supply run to Copernicus Base.

Fast Zombies are extremely quick and agile, being able to climb, run, and jump faster and farther than a normal zombie. They lack any skin or organs and are only comprised of their skeleton and muscles. Its predecessor is the Zombie Assassin.

Basri Ket is a Human, former planeswalker, and sand-mage from Amonkhet. He's a paladin devoted to Oketra, who evangelized the virtue of solidarity. His magic appears as a swirling golden aura of sand.
Baishya (or Bai for short) was a human Atarka-clan girl with developing shamanistic powers in the past of Tarkir. She was the granddaughter of Yasova Dragonclaw, and twin sister of Naiva.

Captain Sisay was the Zhalfirin captain of the skyship Weatherlight and an important figure in the Weatherlight Saga. She was immune to magic, a trait she passed on to her descendant, Shanna.
Shisato (SHEE-sah-toh) was an orochi renegade known for her cunning and ruthlessness. She hunted Dosan's monks. Her venom was so strong that a few drops could kill another orochi.

Baltrice is a red-aligned planeswalker, at least 6 feet tall with broad shoulders and ash-grey hair. She is the loyal lieutenant of the artificer Tezzeret, working for the Infinite Consortium. Being a pyromancer, she specializes in fire elementals though she seems to have learned some of the art of artifice from Tezzeret.

Lurrus of the Dream-Den is a female cat nightmare from the plane of Ikoria. Lurrus makes its den in the Indatha lowlands. The planeswalker Vivien Reid stumbled upon its lair while exploring, and found a litter of adorable nightmare kittens inside. Lurrus apparently has the ability to appear and disappear at will, because when Vivien tried to take a closer look at the kittens, Lurrus appeared from a wisp of smoke. Vivien quickly made her exit. Lurrus fought in defense of Ikoria during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.
Arlinn Kord is a tormented werewolf planeswalker from the Kessig province of the plane of Innistrad. She is the protector of the Ulvenwald.
Kithkin are a quick and agile race of small humanoids, mostly associated with white mana. The first card to bear the creature type was Amrou Kithkin in Legends.

Alexi was a female Zephyr spellshaper on Jamuraa. She was known for her impressive wielding of rhystic magic. Alexi aided the forces of Barrin and Teferi in the Kipamu League against the Keldon invasion. She earned such a reputation among the Keldons that they cursed her, even without knowing her name. She is possibly an ancestor of Linessa.
The Hladvora is a nightmarish shapeshifter on Innistrad who tricks its victims into its lair and traps them there, feeding on their fear.

Gwendolyn Carthalion (née Gwendolyn Mor) was a blue mage, the daughter of Grenfell Mor, and the wife of Adam Carthalion, as well as Jared Carthalion’s mother. Adam sacrificed her to the “god” Ravidel in his quest to become a planeswalker.
Geyadrone Dihada is a powerful and ancient shapeshifter demonic planeswalker who first appeared on Dominaria between the fall of the Thran and the Brothers' War.

Falconers were men and women who watched over the Serra Aviary on Ulgrotha. They could speak with birds, such as Mesa Falcons, an ability which was passed from one falconer to the next. The last known Falconer was Soraya.

Drathka was a wizard who had made a deal with the ruler of Thorun, whose name is not known. The ruler would sponsor Drathka for the spellcasting contest in exchange for political power and renewed youth. However, Drathka eventually wanted to up his gains and bid the ruler also give him his next-born child. The ruler vehemently refused Drathka, but the wizard spat an evil threat before teleporting away. The outcome of this dispute is unknown.

Cullinarn was the master of the House of Oor-tael in Estark , on Dominaria, and the father of Garth One-eye. He was tall, red-haired, with beard and mustache cropped short, and wore a circlet of turquoise stones upon his brow. Choryu was a talented water wizard of the Minamo Academy on Kamigawa. He was a friend of princess Michiko Konda. Unbeknownst to her, he was also an agent of Minamo and its soratami masters, placed in Michiko's vicinity to ensure that the princess's activities were monitored. He was of medium height, with a white mane of hair.

Stalkers are enemies found in Midgard and Vanaheim in God of War Ragnarök. They appeared to be a centaur-like hybrid creature with antlers (half-human, half-Horse). They are strong as well as fast thanks to their Horse half, with their primary method of attack being at range with their bow, however they are no slouch in close combat either. As such, they should be treated as minibosses.
Rocs are giant birds who hover in the air, slashing at their prey with awesome fury.

Dr. Vincent Stegron, commonly known as Stegron the Dinosaur Man is a character from Reality: 616. He is a supervillain with the abilities and a look of a humanoid dinosaur.

Sōryū Tenra (蒼龍天羅, Blue Dragon Heaven Silk) : The ultimate secret technique of Hokuto Shin Ken, said to be the "Fist of the Blue Sky". From the Nyoninzo aura's palm comes an all-enveloping tōki that allows the two combatants to fight in a void of total nothingness. Within the Sōryū Tenra neither of combatant can use any spirit/aura/ki related abilities and only have to fight hand to hand. Until Liu Zongwu, none who witnessed Sōryū Tenra had lived to tell the tale.

Ylgr is a Book II character from Fire Emblem Heroes. She is the youngest of the Nifl royal siblings. She has the power to communicate with others through her dreams like the rest of her siblings; however, her power is less pronounced than her eldest sisters' and she cannot recall her dreams in great detail when she awakens. Naive and brimming with curiosity, she's eager to explore new horizons.

Ymir is a Warrior and is one of the exclusive characters in Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon. He is a villager of a Grustian town who is giant in size, which causes people to call him an ogre. However, he does show care for them and even fights on his own in order to save the villagers, who fell into a trap by Grust in attempting to eradicate them all. Later, Marth's army arrives there to help. Because of their mutual intention to save the villagers, Marth soon convinces Ymir to join the army. When the War of Shadows is over, Ymir heads home to his Grustian village.

Tiena is the one of the three main characters of the Fire Emblem: Hasha no Tsurugi manga. The headstrong princess of the Lycian territory of Tania, she travels alongside her companions Al and Gant to find the Fire Emblem and ultimately put an end to the war with Bern. She is proficient in healing magic, making her an invaluable asset to her allies. The Marquess of Worde, Lord Ranward, is her uncle. The staff Tiena's Staff in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade, is a reference to her.

Teodor is a boss character in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade. Although he identifies himself as the Shrike, he is described as the Black Fang's Shadow Hawk, as the name Shrike actually belongs to Kenneth. He is found in obscure ruins located near the Dragon's Gate, previously used by Nergal, where Eliwood and his group are resting. After a brief conversation, Teodor launches into an attack, where he will summon black fog and create a Fog of War map, and then teleport himself deep into the ruins.

Nailah is a playable character in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn. She is the ruler of the lost nation of Hatari, located to the east of Daein. She is a white wolf and through the skill Formshift has the ability to transform (and keep her wolf form) whenever she wants.

Mannu is an enemy character in Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon and the Blade of Light and Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon. He is a Manakete king who rules over the reclusive Pyrathi isles, a safe haven to his pirate gangs. He threatens Marth and his Altean army when they enter his territory as they are trying to escape from Grustian forces allied with Dolhr. There is not much known about him, aside from that he believes himself superior to any human. Matrona is a Staff from Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn. An SS rank staff in Radiant Dawn, the Matrona staff grants its user the ability to completely restore the HP of a selected ally unit, alongside shifting his/her Biorhythm to the best possible position.

Mage Dragon is both a race and a class of Dragons in the Fire Emblem series, first appearing in Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon and the Blade of Light. An uncommon type of Dragon, Mage Dragons expel either Magic or Dark Breath in order to damage their foes.

Hríd is a Book II character from Fire Emblem Heroes. He is the first prince of the Ice Kingdom Nifl; He is the older brother of Princesses Gunnthrá, Fjorm and Ylgr, making him the eldest royalty of Nifl. He has the power to communicate with others through his dreams like the rest of his siblings; however, his power is less pronounced than Gunnthra's and he cannot recall his dreams in great detail when he awakens.

The Ice Dragon is both a race and a class of Dragons that is first introduced in Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem. An uncommon type of Dragon, Ice Dragons expel Ice Breath in order to damage their foes. The Ice Dragon race also appears in The Blazing Blade, where it acts as the true identity of the mysterious sibling pair Ninian and Nils.

Gunnthrá is a Book II character from Fire Emblem Heroes. She is the First Princess of Nifl, the younger sister of Hríd, and the older sister of Fjorm and Ylgr. She possesses the ability to communicate with others through her dreams as well as receive prophetic dreams. She shares this ability with her siblings. Performing the Rite of Dreams gives her more power over her dreams, allowing her to recall them in great detail even when she's awake.
The Evil Dragon is an enemy-only class that first appeared in TearRing Saga: Utna Heroes Saga. The personal class of Kranion, it is an Earth Dragon that has become feral and attacks with its breath.
Daoud is a playable character from TearRing Saga: Berwick Saga. He leads the retreat from Highland when the Raze Empire invades, using his herculean strength to protect wounded soldiers.

The furtive filcher is a tiny, shadowy, vaguely humanoid form. More resembling a wisp of shadow than a homunculus, the furtive filcher is only tall. This homunculus is quick, and is designed for the express purpose of stealing objects on behalf of its owner. The furtive fincher is created from clay and ash.
A facade is a shapechanging creature that often takes the form of a building or a similar inanimate object.

Briar is a member of the Greensingers from the Eldeen Reaches. This young nonbinary elf acts as an ambassador of sorts between Thelanis and Breland, and is said to have been raised by the archfey Lady Perilous, causing fortune to bend in unusual ways around them. Some say that the greensinger can shapeshift into other people, not only animals, while others believe that they had knowledge of a song so powerful it would allow them to cast wish, at the cost of their own life.

A chaos beast is a horrible and ever-changing creature of the planes. Its lethal touch can transform a victim into an amorphous mass, and ultimately a chaos beast themselves. They are denizens of Kythri, the Churning Chaos.
A barghest is a kind of evil shapechanging fiend found in the plane of Mabar, the Endless Night.

Bennin Silverclaw was a powerful shifter tracker and hunter who lived during the time of the Silver Crusade and is a hero to both shifters and the Church of the Silver Flame. He was famous for helping to prove to the church that shifters were a separate race from lycanthropes. Bennin participated in the Silver Crusade against lycanthropy and with his magically silver-coated claws he was feared by many werebeasts. It is said in the annals of the church that he hunted down and slew no less than fifty lycanthropes of various types. He perished leading an expedition into the Demon Wastes against a lycanthrope cult.

Arcadian avengers are winged warriors native to the plane of Daanvi. They frequently travel to Shavarath, where they fight against the demons and devils trying to conquer that plane. Arcadian avengers have been known to travel to Eberron, where they hunt down the chaotic creatures of the Demon Wastes. Some have even been known to remain on Khorvaire, where more than one was seen participating in the Last War.
This article is about the creature. For the geographical region in Xen'drik, see The Hydra. Hydras are reptilian creatures known for their multiple regenerating heads.
Hippogriffs are winged creatures that resemble a combination of an eagle and a horse. They are used as flying mounts in Khorvaire, usually provided by House Vadalis.

Hill giants are the weakest kind of true giants, but they are still far larger and stronger than most humanoids. Like other giants, they can be found in small tribes in Xen'drik, but a significant number of hill giants are also present in Droaam near the Graywall Mountains.

Conqee Cenva (d. 210 BG) was the mother of Zufa Cenva and a Sorceress of Rossak. She was killed under mysterious circumstances while traveling to the Unallied Worlds. Conqee abhorred her granddaughter, the dwarf woman Norma Cenva, who had faint memories of her grandmother.
